Develop, maintain and defend the contract baseline programme as required by FIDIC Clause 8 (Programme) and the Employer's Requirements. - Integrate design, permits and licences, procurement, fabrication, construction, testing, commissioning and handover. - Build a clean CPM network: complete logic, no open ends, justified constraints, a clear critical path. 2. Updates and progress. Update the programme at the agreed frequency and whenever it no longer reflects actual progress. - Collect progress from site, design (the design subcontractor) and permitting (the permits consultant). - Produce look-ahead programmes (3 and 6 weeks) for the construction team. 3. Change management.
